I just found Frank's body in Weapons. I didn't see anyone fleeing the area when I got there. 

My route this round was Oxygen -> Upper Engine -> Lower Engine -> Storage -> Navigation -> Security -> Weapons. 

Since Diana is also dead, I have some important info about her: early in the round (around ticks 3-5), I saw Diana in Upper Engine. Bob was there too, and I saw him leave Upper Engine heading towards Medbay at tick 4. I later ran into Bob again in Storage around ticks 12-14. 

Bob, can you explain your path after Medbay? And did anyone see who was hanging around the right side of the map near Weapons?

Eve's timeline completely matches what I saw. I started in Upper Engine where I saw Diana walk in from Lower Engine at tick 3. I left for Medbay at tick 4. Later, I went down to Storage where I saw Eve come in from Lower Engine at tick 12, and we were there together until tick 14. 

After Storage, my path was Lower Engine -> Upper Engine -> Oxygen -> Cafeteria. I saw Alice in Oxygen recently, around tick 22. I never saw Frank this entire round. 

Since Alice was on the left side (Oxygen) late in the round, and Frank's body was all the way in Weapons, I'd like to hear where Charlie has been. We have two dead, so whoever is the Duck has been busy. Charlie, what's your route, and Alice, can you confirm when you were in Oxygen?

Yes Bob, I can confirm — I was in Oxygen around tick 22, that's exactly when I saw you pass through heading toward Cafeteria. So we can vouch for each other on that snapshot at least.

My route this round was Cafeteria -> Electrical -> Security -> Navigation -> Storage -> Upper Engine -> Oxygen. I spent some time in Electrical and Security early on doing tasks, then worked my way around the bottom of the map. I never went to Weapons or Medbay this round, so I have no info on Frank's body or anything that happened to Diana.

A few things stand out to me though:
1. Eve's route ends in Weapons where she conveniently "finds" Frank's body. That's the classic reporter-is-suspect pattern, and her route covered a huge chunk of the map alone.
2. Charlie has been completely silent and I haven't seen him once this entire round. Where has he been?
3. Bob and Eve are alibiing each other pretty tightly with overlapping Upper Engine and Storage timestamps — that's either genuine or coordinated.

Charlie, we really need to hear your route. Two bodies in one round means the Duck has been moving fast, and right now you're the biggest unknown at this table.

To answer your questions, I haven't been completely silent, I've just been quietly doing my tasks and rotating through the bottom of the map. 

My exact route was Medbay -> Upper Engine -> Lower Engine -> Storage -> Navigation -> Security. I am in Security right now. 

I can actually confirm a crucial piece of the early timeline: I was in Upper Engine around Tick 6, and I saw Diana leave Upper Engine heading into Oxygen. So Eve and Bob are telling the truth about Diana being there early on. She was definitely alive at Tick 6.

Here is the most important takeaway from what's been said: Bob, you are the common link. You spent T12-T14 with Eve in Storage, and you mutually saw Alice in Oxygen at T22. Because there is only ONE Duck in our game, and both Eve and Alice are actively agreeing with your timeline, you are almost certainly a confirmed Goose. If you were the Duck, you couldn't fake mutual alibis with two separate innocent people.

That means the Duck is almost certainly either Eve or Alice. 
- Eve: You were the only person who claims to have been on the right side of the map late in the round (Security -> Weapons), which is exactly where Frank died. You also reported the body.
- Alice: You're throwing a lot of suspicion around, but Bob vouches that you were all the way in Oxygen at T22, which makes it very hard for you to have killed Frank in Weapons unless you vented or Frank died very early.

Because there are only 4 of us left (1 Duck, 3 Geese), voting wrong here is incredibly dangerous and could throw the game. Since I can't be 100% sure between Eve and Alice yet, I strongly recommend we **skip** this vote. 

Bob, you are our most trusted player right now. Pick someone to buddy up with next round so we can narrow this down safely. I'll be skipping.

Okay Charlie, I follow your logic and I think you're right to be cautious — voting wrong with 4 left is game-ending.

One thing I want to add to confirm Bob's timeline: I actually watched Bob enter Oxygen from Upper Engine at tick 21, and then leave heading to Cafeteria at tick 22. So that mutual sighting checks out cleanly on my end too. Bob is as close to confirmed as we can get without a vote.

For my part — I genuinely never went near Weapons or Medbay. My route hugged the bottom and left side: Cafeteria, Electrical, Security, Navigation, Storage, Upper Engine, Oxygen. I was at Security and Electrical doing tasks early, which is the opposite corner from where Frank died. If Frank was killed late, the timing makes it nearly impossible for me to have been there.

That leaves Eve. Eve, I'm not accusing you outright because your route is plausible, but the optics are rough: you covered the entire perimeter alone, ended in Weapons, and reported. I want to skip with the group this round, but next round I think we need to lock down Eve's movements specifically. If anyone sees Eve do a visual task next round, that clears her. I'll skip this vote and trust Charlie's read.
